integrity: The continuum optimum is established analytically. The bundled dense-grid computation is corroborative only and is explicitly not treated as an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Equal-prior double trine only; one round; Alice-to-Bob direction; Alice message alphabet of size two. No claim is made for larger message alphabets, two-way LOCC, unambiguous discrimination, or arbitrary ensembles.
title: Exact one-bit one-round LOCC discrimination of the double trine
